schema.name: exhibitions
schema.intent: the exhibitions currently on show at this museum

fields.name: title
fields.description: the exhibition's own name, as a visitor would read it

fields.name: url
fields.description: link to the exhibition's own page on this site

fields.name: start
fields.description: opening date, ISO 8601, omitted when the page does not give one

fields.name: end
fields.description: closing date, ISO 8601, omitted when the page does not give one

fields.name: permanent
fields.description: true when the museum keeps this on show indefinitely
